title: Second Battle of Timbuktu
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Second Battle of Timbuktu", at revision 1370736664, opens: "The Second Battle of Timbuktu was a battle during the Mali War between March 30 and April 1, 2013, in which two Islamist attacks targeted the Malian army in Timbuktu." Wikidata item Q9101600, whose own description reads "2013 battle". That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does.
